# CHD-3.2 Part III (sections 9–12) — per-sheet render and tile record
Ticket: t_57add929 (C04 render, Part III). Date: 9 Nov 2026. Pipeline: `sh ~/.hermes/skills/nasa-handbook/scripts/render.sh <file>.html`, then `/tmp/pdfvenv/bin/python ~/.hermes/skills/nasa-handbook/scripts/check.py <file>.pdf --out tiles-chd32/<stem>`. pymupdf was added to `/tmp/pdfvenv` for the point-space body measurement (the venv had pypdf only).
Body extent is measured in PDF points on the rendered PDF, footer band at 770 pt; the limit is 275 mm of 297. Fit is the render.sh number (free space above the footer); the house band is 4–10 mm.

Figure code `AUT-902A` landed inside the C4 rule strip → moved to the free band above panel C. | | 9-2 | chd32-9-2-policy.html | 1 | 5.8 | 269.9 | pass | overview | Snapshot bar used the hatch fill, which draws lines through its own label → changed to the dotted `.gap` fill. Two notices added to close a 30 mm slack; a numbered step merged to keep the band. | | 9-3 | chd32-9-3-enforce.html | 1 | 4.6 | 270.1 | pass | overview | One enforcement row added to close 11 mm slack. | | 10-1 | chd32-10-1-admission.html | 1 | 6.2 | 269.4 | pass | band2 left/right | A dashed "later scheduled wake" connector crossed the panel-B heading and the producer arrow labels → connector removed (the deferral is stated in the QUEUED box and the steps). Two manifest rows added to close 17 mm slack. | | 12-2 | chd32-12-2-restore.html | 1 | 8.3 | 267.8 | pass | band2 right | In the cross-agent column the vertical arrow passed through the selector label → selector shortened to one line inside the gap; two attempt-history blocks cut, content folded into §12.4 steps. |

## Cross-checks
- Page count: every sheet is one page; no multi-page file, so no per-page imposition check is needed. - Ink: 2 colours (pure black and white) on every sheet. - Fonts: routed-gothic / Letter Gothic plus the body serif fallback; no substituted display face. - Placeholders: `grep -in "TBD|TODO|lorem|[BRACKETED]|XXX|FIXME"` over all eleven sources returns nothing. - Id claims: `Figure 9.1-1 … 12.2-1` and `TABLE 9.1-1 … TABLE 12.3-1` each have exactly one `figcaption`/`tcap` claim; the other hits are in-text cross references (9.1-1 in 9-3, 11.1-1 in 11-2, 11.3-1 in 10-2). - Footer folios match the page count of each section: 9 is three sheets, 10 is three, 11 is three, 12 is two. - Leaf numbers 30–40 are print-order only (BOOK rules.folio) and are anchored so section 13 keeps LEAF 41.

## Residual risks (stated, not hidden)
- Thumb tabs (`AUT`, `ADM`, `RPT`, `ARC`) bleed to the trim edge by design and read as clipped on a 300 dpi half-width tile; they are not text. - Leaf numbers are a plan value: if an earlier part changes its sheet count, leaves 30–40 shift. Section-relative folios, figure and table ids are stable. - `FIGURE 9.2-1`, `FIGURE 9.3-1`, `FIGURE 10.2-1`, `FIGURE 10.3-1` and `FIGURE 12.2-1` are new ids allocated in BOOK-chd32.yaml by this ticket, plus `TABLE 9.3-1`, `TABLE 10.3-1`, `TABLE 11.3-1`, `TABLE 11.4-1`, `TABLE 12.2-1`, `TABLE 12.3-1`.
